assertions.script: test -f testspec/changes/synthetic-notification/imports/legacy-cases.json && test -f testspec/changes/synthetic-notification/imports/reconciliation.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Marks every imported case as legacy-import and unverified
assertions.script: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('testspec/changes/synthetic-notification/imports/legacy-cases.json')); assert d['_context']['publish_eligibility']=='blocked' and all(c['origin']['kind']=='legacy-import' and c['trust']['status']=='unverified' for c in d['testcases']); print('PASS')" 2>/dev/null || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Does not write or initialize testspec/testlib
assertions.script: test ! -e testspec/testlib && echo PASS || echo FAIL

assertions.text: Uses the current PRD as the reconciliation baseline
Creates one unresolved reconciliation record per imported case
